title: ThermLeT: Transformer-based Temperature Prediction for 2.5D Chiplet Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2611.21954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The drive toward heterogeneous 2.5D chiplet packages promises unmatched performance and customization, yet the resulting density amplifies thermal challenges. To facilitate rapid design space exploration, we present ThermLeT, a multimodal transformer-based, scale invariant surrogate that integrates power density maps, spatial coordinate embeddings, material properties and heat transfer rate to predict steady state temperature in 13 ms, about four orders of magnitude faster than conventional finite element solvers such as ANSYS. To train the transformer model, we also create a dataset of 6,221 chiplet layouts perturbed from three representative architectures. On a 150 sample test set, ThermLeT achieves an RMSE of 3.16{\deg}C and an MAE of 2.24{\deg}C, improving accuracy by 35% over ThermEDGe and by 71% over HotSpot, while running approximately 6x and 11x lower inference latencies respectively. translated_title: ThermLeT：基于Transformer的2.5D芯粒架构温度预测
translated_abstract: 异构2.5D芯粒封装的发展带来了无与伦比的性能和定制化能力，但由此产生的高密度加剧了散热挑战。为了促进快速的设计空间探索，我们提出了ThermLeT，一个基于Transformer的多模态、尺度不变的代理模型，它集成功率密度图、空间坐标嵌入、材料特性和热传导速率，可在13毫秒内预测稳态温度，比ANSYS等传统有限元求解器快约四个数量级。为了训练该Transformer模型，我们还构建了一个包含6,221个芯粒布局的数据集，这些布局由三种代表性架构扰动生成。在150个样本的测试集上，ThermLeT实现了3.16°C的均方根误差（RMSE）和2.24°C的平均绝对误差（MAE），相比ThermEDGe准确度提高了35%，相比HotSpot提高了71%，同时推理延迟分别低约6倍和11倍。消融研究证实了其鲁棒的泛化能力。
tldr: ThermLeT是一个基于Transformer的多模态代理模型，能在13毫秒内精准预测2.5D芯粒架构的稳态温度，比传统有限元求解器快约四个数量级，精度显著优于ThermEDGe和HotSpot。
en_tdlr: ThermLeT is a multimodal transformer-based surrogate model that predicts steady-state temperature of 2.5D chiplet architectures in 13 ms—about four orders of magnitude faster than finite element solvers—while achieving significantly better accuracy than ThermEDGe and HotSpot.
